resources.string: Lets your WorkBuddy cat live in the status bar, run Focus mode (ask how long you want in the apps you picked, then close them by pressing Home when the time is up), swat away Reels and Shorts by pressing Back, suggest breaks after a while in distracting apps, and tap her tiny keyboard while you type. It only checks which app and screen is open, where the status bar icons are, and that you are typing, never what you type. Nothing is stored or sent anywhere.
Focus session done! Stretch and take 5 🐾
Time for a glass of water 💧
Your WorkBuddy cat says: stay hydrated 🐾
